description: A utility class containing miscellaneous static helper methods for data manipulation, collection handling, locale parsing, phone number parsing, file copying, and other general-purpose functions within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: UtilMisc
classes.description: A final class with static utility methods for various data and collection operations, locale parsing, phone number parsing, file copying, etc.

methods.name: initCause
methods.description: Initializes the cause of a Throwable.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Comparable objects or two Lists for equality.

methods.name: toIterator
methods.description: Converts a collection to an iterator, returning null if the collection is null.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Creates a map from key-value pairs provided as varargs.

methods.name: printMap
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a map with key --> value per line.

methods.name: makeListWritable
methods.description: Creates a mutable LinkedList from a collection.

methods.name: makeMapWritable
methods.description: Creates a mutable HashMap from a Map.

methods.name: makeMapSerializable
methods.description: Removes non-Serializable values from a Map.

methods.name: makeArrayListSerializable
methods.description: Removes non-Serializable objects from an ArrayList.

methods.name: sortMaps
methods.description: Sorts a list of maps by specified keys.

methods.name: getMapFromMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an inner map within an outer map.

methods.name: getListFromMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a list within an outer map.

methods.name: addToBigDecimalInMap
methods.description: Adds a BigDecimal value to a map entry, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: removeFirst
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element of a list.

methods.name: collectionToSet
methods.description: Converts a collection to a LinkedHashSet, removing null.

methods.name: collectionToString
methods.description: Concatenates collection elements into a string separated by delimiter.

methods.name: toSet
methods.description: Creates a set from varargs or collection.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Creates a list from varargs.

methods.name: addToListInMap
methods.description: Adds an element to a list stored in a map.

methods.name: addToSetInMap
methods.description: Adds an element to a set stored in a map.

methods.name: addToSortedSetInMap
methods.description: Adds an element to a sorted set stored in a map.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Converts an object to a double primitive.

methods.name: toDoubleObject
methods.description: Converts an object to Double, or null if not possible.

methods.name: toInteger
methods.description: Converts an object to int primitive.

methods.name: toIntegerObject
methods.description: Converts an object to Integer, or null if not possible.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Converts an object to long primitive.

methods.name: toLongObject
methods.description: Converts an object to Long, or null if not possible.

methods.name: parseLocale
methods.description: Parses a locale string into a Locale object.

methods.name: ensureLocale
methods.description: Ensures an object is a Locale, parsing string or returning default.

methods.name: availableLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of available locales sorted by display name.

methods.name: getHostHeadersAllowed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of allowed host headers for security.

methods.name: staticWait
methods.description: Deprecated method for Thread.sleep().

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from source to target.

methods.name: getViewLastIndex
methods.description: Calculates last index for paginated views.

methods.name: splitPhoneNumber
methods.description: Parses a phone number into country code, area code, and contact number.
